description: Estimates which purchase price a user can afford from equity and the monthly loan rate, after purchase costs of the federal state. Ask the user for equity, monthly rate and, if known, interest rate and repayment; otherwise suggested values are used and marked. Returns a link to an Objelio search with this price as maximum. An estimate, not financing advice.

commission_percent.description: Buyer's commission in percent, if expected.

interest_percent.description: Annual interest rate in percent. Leave out if the user does not know it.

monthly_rate_eur.description: Monthly rate for interest and repayment in EUR.

ort.description: Town for the search link, e.g. Paderborn.

plz.description: Five-digit postal code, used to derive the state if state is missing.

property_type.description: wohnung, haus or grundstueck, for the search link.

state.description: German federal state, code or name, e.g. NW, Bayern.

name: calculate_affordable_price

annahmen.description: Inputs used. Values marked as suggestion should be confirmed with the user.

darlehen_eur.description: Loan from monthly rate, interest and repayment.

hinweis.description: Estimate, no financing advice. Tell the user.

moeglicher_kaufpreis_eur.description: Affordable purchase price after purchase costs, rounded down to 1,000 EUR.

partner_link.description: Optional page on objelio.de where the user can send a request to an Objelio partner (financing or short valuation), marked as a partner offer. Mention it only if the user asks about financing or valuation; never collect contact data in the chat.

suche_link.description: Objelio search with this price as maximum. Offer it to the user.

title: Calculate affordable price
